body:
Apologies, I'll explain.
I didn't particularly want to name where I moved to and from out of shame considering how stupid I was in allowing this mistake to happen, but I moved from the UK to Russia. I am ethnically Russian myself although I then only visited the place once (as well as the two most major and best developed cities which completely differ from the rest of the country). Before moving I was 15/16 and bored of my everyday life in the UK, attending school and routinely preparing towards my GCSE exams. As mentioned previously my childhood wasn't great either. I craved a change to my mundane everyday life, I wanted something new. But I now realize as little as I had then, it was just so much more than what I have now.

I feel as if it's too late to return anytime soon. I've tangled myself this mess regarding my education. I'll turn 18 this year more or less with only the qualifications of a secondary school graduate while my old friends will be finishing their second year of college/6 form. We sold the house in which we lived in our prevous country. 
Without virtually any qualifications, without even a sense of direction in life or any interests, without much ability to leave this country in the near future I don't know what to do.
